### Popular Browser Extensions

- **[ChatGPT to Word or PDF - Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-word-or-pdf/mjdmggegbkookpcmbdllcnbfboikcbop?hl=en):** Adds a one-click export button under individual responses and at the top of chats to save content as a Word (`.docx` ) or PDF file while keeping formatting intact.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-word-or-pdf/mjdmggegbkookpcmbdllcnbfboikcbop)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lUPpPt46YxU)
- **[Convert ChatGPT to Google Doc, Microsoft Word, PDF](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/convert-chatgpt-to-google/iapioliapockkkikccgbiaalfhoieano):** Supports Chrome, Brave, and Edge for one-click conversions into Word, Google Docs, or PDF.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/convert-chatgpt-to-google/iapioliapockkkikccgbiaalfhoieano)
- **ChatGPT to PDF, Word, Markdown & Google Docs (Firefox Add-on):** Available for Firefox users to export chats directly to Word or Google Drive.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF17jtx_IIU03hF-4G7XR6yhxaWrhAczd_5Y71hQoByP_1ICuerJ7q9Z-TlnwqkZOMEzadmzeR9mumBjtaDyOwV5p4vUUeUNTEamgYqWS8beHaefDz1B1UNIFbECK6ZC58yadRBUFn5JdxpmfkrKKiWqUNPmqQD1vVnICDUhV4jH3KRRjdgw)

### Official Microsoft Word Integration

- **[ChatGPT for Word](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHEIkXXJBFgTaqCOd38zBfF5wKUwnpfQIR0nEK5jXNv3-qRO5V1nNAVqgednTThANT0nYCDMoNxUGCDSGumC2BrOgtTXJjeL6Y4VVKeYnkq3zcOIjxbnUiQ0e8):** You can install the official ChatGPT add-in from the Microsoft Marketplace to draft, edit, and format text directly inside Microsoft Word using your ChatGPT account.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHEIkXXJBFgTaqCOd38zBfF5wKUwnpfQIR0nEK5jXNv3-qRO5V1nNAVqgednTThANT0nYCDMoNxUGCDSGumC2BrOgtTXJjeL6Y4VVKeYnkq3zcOIjxbnUiQ0e8)
